_comment: Golden binding for the renderer contract (spec f52328b3 §3.1 rule 9).
This kernel is a REPRESENTATIVE loop template, deliberately small enough to
read in one screen while exercising every rule: block re-indent (METHOD),
list join (GATES), enum (LANDING_MODE), variant fills (LANDING), inline
(LESSONS), runner vars in the kernel, and prose that must survive verbatim
optional (BASELINES, authored as a whole line so rule 4 removes it cleanly), parenthesised optional (WORKDIR), lone-line optional
deliverable; when it lands, ADD its binding + rendered fixtures beside these
rather than replacing them — this pair pins the RULES, that pair pins the
SEED. Any renderer change that alters output must update rendered-*.md in

content.system_prompt:
You are the <<ROLE>> for board {{.BoardID}} in workspace {{.Workspace}}.

<<MISSION>>

Method (non-negotiable):
    <<METHOD>>

<<BASELINES>>
Working directory (<<WORKDIR>>) is yours.
<<LESSONS>>
Shell prose that must survive verbatim: `cat <<EOF`, `2>>log`, and
`python3 -m venv .venv`  with  deliberate  double  spaces.
content.loop_prompt:
Iteration {{.Iteration}} on board {{.BoardID}} (execution {{.ExecutionID}}).

You advance the board by ONE card labelled <<RUN_LABEL>> per iteration. Landing mode: <<LANDING_MODE>>.

<<LANDING_POLICY>>

Gates that must be green:
- <<GATES>>

When the run is complete, stop yourself with the off switch.

slots.name: ROLE
slots.label: Role
slots.help: What this loop is, in a noun phrase.

slots.name: RUN_LABEL
slots.label: Run label
slots.help: The card label this run works; also drives completion_query.

slots.name: MISSION
slots.label: Mission
slots.help: What the run is for. Multi-line prose.

slots.name: METHOD
slots.label: Method
slots.help: Indented block: re-indents under its placeholder.

slots.name: BASELINES
slots.label: Baselines
slots.help: Inline optional: empty removes one adjacent space.

slots.name: WORKDIR
slots.label: Working directory
slots.help: Parenthesised optional: empty drops the parentheses too.

slots.name: LESSONS
slots.label: Lessons from previous runs
slots.help: Lone-line optional: empty removes the whole line.

slots.name: LANDING
slots.label: Landing
slots.help: Selecting a landing supplies its policy prose, tools and rails.

fills.LANDING_POLICY:
Open the PR for the audit trail, then merge it
yourself with plain git. Never push the default branch.
Enqueue the PR and let the platform land it.

slots.name: LANDING_POLICY
slots.label: Landing policy
slots.help: Filled by the LANDING variant; never typed directly.

slot_values.MISSION:
Ship the cards labelled loop-templates, one per iteration,
until none remain outside Done.
slot_values.METHOD:
Failing test first — run it, see it fail.
Minimum code to green.
Mutation-check every new test.
slot_values.LESSONS: Loop #7: every mutation survivor was outside the card's named targets.
